title: moa project config (.moa.yml)
description:
Source of truth for the per-project workflow. YAML is parsed as a safe subset (no anchors, no merge keys, no duplicate keys, known keys only) and normalized to this JSON before execution. Names NO specific CLI; runtime specifics live in binding packages.

SERIALIZATION STANDARD (what `init` emits, what templates follow): (1) Every key is MONOMORPHIC — one YAML type, always; no key is 'sometimes a scalar, sometimes an array'. Every multi-value field is an array (incl. 'effort'); every named collection ('models' registry, 'roles') is a map. (2) STYLE: block style for all maps; flow style ONLY for short scalar arrays (e.g. tags: [strong, fast], use: [opus, auto]) and for the tabular step rows under pipelines.<name>.steps ({ phase, role, gate }). (3) EMPTIES: empty map -> {}, empty list -> []. (4) DEFAULTS: omit any key equal to its schema default; write a key only to override.

resolution.description: Route each role to the binding that serves its model; constraint-first, then prefer native.

subagents.description: Spawn-source policy — a filter on binding routing. auto: best available (prefer cross-family/external for gate verifiers, fall back to host-native). native: host-native subagents only. external: learned-tool subagents only. blocked: no subagents (master works solo, self-check only). Default auto prompts only at consequential forks (first external-tool use; critical work with no independent verifier) and offers to pin; a pinned value runs silent. The verification grade reached (cross-family > cross-model > self-check) is always named; only master.mode strict halts a critical gate with no different-model verifier.

models.description: Selected model preferences, keyed by project alias. Init writes only aliases used by roles, never the full host or learned-tool inventory. Configured aliases remain distinct candidates even when they share one canonical model ID. Roles select aliases through roles.<name>.use.

id.description: Exact canonical provider/model ID. If omitted, the alias itself must be canonical.

effort.description: Reasoning/thinking effort — ALWAYS an array (one shape, never a bare scalar). A single-element array (e.g. ['medium'], or the default ['auto'] to let the binding choose) PINS one effort. A multi-element ascending array (e.g. ['low','medium','xhigh']) is an escalation LADDER: the master starts at rung 0 and climbs one rung per gate loop-back. Overrides any ':<effort>' suffix baked into 'id'/key; ignored by models without effort control.

tags.description: Capability labels — the successor to tier names. The master matches these when a role uses 'auto', and the floor 'master.hardVerificationTags' filters on them. Conventional: strong, cheap, fast, vision. Freeform welcome: maths, architecture, hard, smol, designer, reasoning, coder, triage.

family.description: Model family/lineage, used for the cross-family preference at gates and to collapse provider aliases of one model (independence itself keys on the model). If omitted, discovered via the binding's serves(). Pinning it makes gate grading deterministic and resolvable offline.

binding.description: Optional exact route pin for this model alias: host-native or one learned tool name. Binding pins belong only on model entries.

provider.description: Optional provider label; usually derivable from the 'id'/key prefix.

context.description: Optional: context-window size in tokens. Lets the master route large tasks to large-context models.

cost.description: Optional coarse cost class for budget-aware routing.

priority.description: Optional tie-break order among tag-matched candidates (lower = preferred). Defaults to declaration order.

enabled.description: Set false to keep a model declared but exclude it from resolution.

master.description: The conductor = the agent running the skill (host agent). Not a spawn target.

mode.description: How literally the master runs the pipeline. 'strict': pipeline verbatim — every declared phase runs with its declared role×model, nothing skipped/merged/inlined, master performs no producing role (use for CI/release). 'auto' (default): master may right-size non-gate, non-critical phases and may author small mutations itself, each with a logged reason — but the gate floor is absolute: every gatesRequired phase runs with the config-resolved model, and verifier independence holds against the ACTUAL producer (the coder, or the master if it authored the change).

modelAdvisory.description: Advisory only: if the host model is weaker than this, lean harder on gates.

hardVerificationTags.description: The hard/critical verifier must be a model carrying ALL these tags (successor to hardVerificationTier). Default ['strong'].

use.description: Ordered model aliases, or the literal auto wildcard. This is the only role-level route selector; roles never pin learned tools directly.

effort.description: Optional per-role reasoning/thinking effort — ALWAYS an array, same shape and rules as models.<name>.effort. A single-element array pins (e.g. ['high']); a multi-element ascending array is an escalation ladder climbed one rung per gate loop-back. Overrides the model's 'effort' and any ':<effort>' suffix baked into its id/key; ignored by models without effort control.

differentModelFrom.description: Role name whose resolved model this role must differ from (different family preferred).

pipelines.description: Named workflows (replaces the flat 'pipeline' list). Each key is a pipeline name. 'default' is special: its PRESENCE selects deterministic workflow mode (run it, right-sized per master.mode); its ABSENCE selects adaptive mode (config-present fork: the master adapts per task — answer inline, run a named pipeline chosen via its 'description', or compose an ad-hoc one from the role palette). 'default' is NOT required; the map may be {} (fully composed adaptive). 'roles' and 'models' are shared across every pipeline.

description.description: One-liner the master uses to auto-select this pipeline for a task. Emit only when the config declares >=2 pipelines; a single-pipeline config selects by name.

phase.description: Phase name; unique within this pipeline (loader-checked).

role.description: A role name, or 'master' for a master-owned phase.

gate.description: Gate tier — collapses the old gate+critical booleans and the top-level gatesRequired list into one field. 'none' (default, omit): a producing/master phase, right-sizeable in auto mode. 'standard': a mandatory checkpoint whose verifier is a DIFFERENT family than the producer (the nearest preceding non-gate, non-master phase). 'critical': standard PLUS the verifier carries all master.hardVerificationTags. No optional gates — a lighter flow is a different pipeline. Because 'critical' is a value of 'gate', 'critical-without-a-gate' is unrepresentable.

loopBackTo.description: Phase to return to on REVISE; must name a phase in this pipeline.
